# Clinical Indicator

This folder contains topic pages detailing clinical indicators used for quality assessment and outcome measurement within the corpus. Specifically, it covers supplementary metrics utilized by the Akut Kirurgi Databasen to evaluate 30-day mortality rates following acute surgery, which stratify patients by their baseline comorbidity burden using the Charlson Score to ensure fair and accurate quality assessments.

## Pages

- [[clinical-indicator|Clinical Indicator]] — Supplementary quality metrics tracking 30-day post-operative mortality for acute surgery patients, stratified by Charlson comorbidity scores.
